name: Nine of Cups
meaning_for_today: Today brings emotional satisfaction, comfort, and a sense of fulfillment. It is a good day to appreciate what you already have and enjoy small pleasures.
card_advice: Allow yourself to feel gratitude and satisfaction, but avoid becoming complacent. True happiness grows when appreciation is balanced with awareness of future goals.

upright.general: Represents emotional fulfillment, happiness, and the realization of wishes. It often indicates a period of comfort, success, and personal satisfaction.
upright.in_love: Emotional harmony and satisfaction in relationships. Wishes in love may be fulfilled, bringing joy and closeness.
upright.in_situation: A situation where goals or desires are achieved. Stability and comfort are present, and things feel aligned with expectations.

reversed.general: Indicates disappointment, unfulfilled desires, or realizing that what was wanted does not bring true happiness.
reversed.in_love: Emotional dissatisfaction or unrealistic expectations in relationships. A need to reassess what truly brings fulfillment.
reversed.in_situation: A situation that looks successful on the surface but lacks deeper satisfaction or meaning.

major.01: New beginnings that may lead to emotional fulfillment
major.06: Values and traditions contributing to happiness
major.11: Changes in fortune bringing emotional rewards
major.18: Dreams and hopes influencing emotional satisfaction
major.21: Completion and achievement of emotional goals

cups.01: New emotional happiness and beginnings of joy
cups.03: Celebration and emotional enjoyment with others
cups.06: Nostalgia and emotional comfort from the past

pentacles.03: Satisfaction from work and skill mastery
pentacles.09: Material comfort contributing to emotional pleasure

swords.04: Rest after emotional or mental struggle leading to peace

wands.03: Anticipation of success and emotional reward
